runsheet.short_description: Use the helpdesk laptop to start the Zoom Meeting.
For each kiosk laptop: join Zoom, stay in Hub.
The helpdesk laptop promotes each kiosk laptop to cohost. Open the breakout session while allowing participants to choose room (see screenshot in More Info).
runsheet.dev_comment: “Allow participants to choose room” is present in account settings too, but ticking it as the default room behavior didn’t work — you still have to manually do this every meeting.

runsheet.short_description: For each kiosk laptop: enter a breakout room; start the Live-Overview observer app. [if presenter on-site] open the poster PDF, start screenshare, click the purple System Picker icon on the top system menu bar, click Presenter Overlay, click Large, show the Zoom floating menu bar. [always] Start “recording to this computer”. [if presenter on-site] Click the green button with a downward arrow to show the remote view, and keep it visible for the presenter.
runsheet.more_info: P2-9 indicated not to be recorded.

runsheet.short_description: Use the helpdesk laptop to screenshare this notice (in More Info) in the Hub. Press 'pause' in Zoom top bar to freeze the screenshare for the laptop to navigate away.
Meet to know one another. Review the [Troubleshoot cheatsheet](#poster-session-helpdesk-on-site-troubleshoot-cheatsheet).

[[Poster Session Helpdesk Online]], join the meeting and stay in the Hub; Rename yourself to “{name} (volunteer)”; Send a message in Zoom Chat to the Meeting Host saying 'make_me_cohost()'; Review the [Troubleshoot cheatsheet](#poster-session-helpdesk-online-troubleshoot-cheatsheet). [[Zoom Master]], make them co-host.

1 [[Poster Session Helpdesk On-site]] + 2 [[Zoom Master]]s = 3 people. Rotate and assign 1 person at the desk, while the other 2 enjoy the Poster Session. The desk person stays available. The enjoyers should check for on-site tech issues periodically. Everyone mind audio balance between on-site and online, and tweak the speakers' volume. [[Zoom Master]]s additionally check [#internal-helpdesk-for-volunteer-and-organizers](https://ismir2026.slack.com/archives/C0CAA9DBFJ6).
runsheet.more_info: Tip. [[Zoom Master]]s are 4-day, while [[Poster Session Helpdesk On-site]] may rotate. [[Zoom Master]]s may coach [[Poster Session Helpdesk On-site]] by demonstration. When resolving issues, call them up to observe.

runsheet.short_description: One stays in the Hub. Verify that the shared screen shows an instruction notice. Listen for questions in the Hub. The other three roam the breakout rooms. All four monitor [#help](https://ismir2026.slack.com/archives/C0C45QQMU6A) and the current #poster-session-x on Slack. Handle requests.
runsheet.more_info: If need assistance, forward the request message to [#internal-helpdesk-for-volunteer-and-organizers](https://ismir2026.slack.com/archives/C0CAA9DBFJ6). If overwhelmed, say so in [#internal-helpdesk-for-volunteer-and-organizers](https://ismir2026.slack.com/archives/C0CAA9DBFJ6) and start forwarding requests. Tip: when handling a request, quickly reply to it (e.g. “Let me help you with this”) so others know you are already on it.

runsheet.short_description: Enjoy the Poster Session. Periodically check [#help](https://ismir2026.slack.com/archives/C0C45QQMU6A) and the current #poster-session-x on Slack.
runsheet.more_info: Refer to the last item for tips.

runsheet.short_description: Walk past every poster of your session. Check that each on-site presenter is at their poster and each online presenter shows on the TV. Report issues to the [[Poster Session Helpdesk On-site]].

Join the Poster Session Zoom Meeting. Check that each online presenter of your session is in their breakout room. If one is missing, ping them on Slack and tell the [[Poster Session Helpdesk Online]].
Circulate among the posters of your session. Bring on-site attendees to the online presenters' posters, and ask on-site discussions to use the mics so online visitors can hear.
Hop between the breakout rooms of your session, starting with quiet ones. Relay the questions from the #oral-session-? threads to the presenters.
From the helpdesk laptop: End meeting for all.
Thank the presenters of your session, on-site and in #poster-session-?.
